description: Only to demo a ref that is not checked out (a branch or PR, or the before of a before/after): adds a temporary git worktree OUTSIDE the repo and returns its path. Install and start the demo instance from that path on a free port, then demo_start with ref set to the same ref. Removed at demo_finish. The developer's checkout is never switched.
name: demo_worktree
title: Check out another ref for a demo
